Event photo courtesy of Tudor Place Historic House roundup March 8, 2026 - By Stephanie Shipman Easter Spring Activities See on map It's time to dust off those baskets and get ready for some Easter egg hunts! Easter egg hunts are one of the top springtime kids' activities, and they're happening all across DC, Maryland, and Northern Virginia for Easter 2026. From toddlers to teens, there is an Easter egg hunt that works for every kid in your family. These even include some free egg hunts! Read on for our list of the best Easter egg hunts at DC parks, farms, churches, and more for family fun. Many of them require advance registration and are filling up fast, so book soon! My Top 5 Easter Events, At a Glance Top Easter Event with Animals: Bunnyland Festival at Butler's Orchard Most Iconic DC Easter Egg Hunt: White House Easter Egg Roll Most Unique Easter Egg Hunt: Underwater Egg Hunt at Reston Community Center Best Mid-Week Easter Egg Hunt: Spring Egg Hunt at Temple Hall Farm Best Free Easter Egg Hunt: Falls Church Easter Egg Hunt Our Easter Activities Guide and Spring Activities Guide for Families have even more fun ways to enjoy the holiday, from awesome Easter movies to easy Easter crafts. Even the animals might get in on the fun at Easter Monday at the National Zoo! Photo courtesy of the event Free Easter Egg Hunts Near DC for Easter 2026 event College Park's Egg-ceptional Egg Hunt Egg-stravaganza event 10:00 am -12:00 pm Saturday, March 21 - Free College Park, MD Ages 10 and under Join in a morning of egg hunting, crafts, music, a visit with Peter Cottontail, prizes, and more at the Egg-ceptional Egg Hunt Egg-stravaganza! Egg hunts are designed for children up to 10 years old and are organized by age groups. Read More event Epworth United Methodist Church Community Easter Egg Hunt event 11:30 am -1:30 pm Pick Saturday, March 28 - Free Gaithersburg, MD Ages 2 and upEpworth UMC hosts its annual community Easter egg hunt with two hunts starting at 12pm and 1pm, plus games, food, and music to entertain kids and adults. Families can also enjoy a moon bounce, craft tables, sports games, cookie decorating, pictures with the Easter Bunny, and more. Read More event EGGnormous Egg Hunt at Sunrise Valley Elementary School event 10:00 am -11:30 am Reston, VA - Free Saturday, March 28 Ages 8 and underThe entire family can enjoy this spring event with live entertainment and a life-size bunny. The egg hunt begins at 10:30am. Kids should bring their own basket for collecting eggs. Read More event Falls Church Easter Egg Hunt event 9:15 am -12:00 pm Falls Church, VA - Free Saturday, April 4 Ages 11 and underChildren are invited to hunt for eggs in Cherry Hill Park, take pictures with the Easter Bunny, and enjoy other fun activities. Read More event Easter Monday at the National Zoo event Various times -11:59 pm Pick Washington, DC - Free Monday, April 6 All agesFamilies are invited to the annual Easter Monday celebration at the National Zoo. Enjoy lots of fun family activities, including an Easter egg hunt with prizes, field games, special animal demonstrations, and live entertainment. Read More event White House Easter Egg Roll event Various times -11:59 pm Pick Washington, DC - Free Monday, April 6 All agesAt the annual White House Easter Egg Roll, guests can enjoy activities for the whole family on the South Lawn of the White House, including storytime, games, live entertainment, and the traditional Easter Egg Roll. Read More How many Easter eggs can your little ones find? Photo by Gabe Pierce courtesy of Unsplash Best Easter Egg Hunts Near DC at Farms and Zoos event Easter Egg Hunts at Great Country Farms event Bluemont, VA Daily, March 19 - April 4 Ages 1-10Great Country Farms hosts daily Easter egg hunts. Families can also see the baby chicks and other baby animals, take a wagon ride, and enjoy the farm's play areas. Read More event Hippity Hoppity Easter Egg Hunt at Green Meadows Petting Farm event Pick Ijamsville , MD March 21-22, March 28-29, and April 2-5 All ages Hippity hop your way to the farm for a spring day full of giggles, fresh air, and egg-citing fun! Green Meadows' Easter Egg Hunt is the perfect way for little bunnies to run, explore, and play while grown-ups kick back and enjoy the farm vibes. Read More event Clark's Elioak Farm Egg Hunts event Ellicott City, MD Daily, March 28-April 5 Ages 1-6Kids ages 1-3 and 4-6 can hunt for eggs at various times each day, which they'll then turn in for a goodie bag. They can also enjoy the petting farm, rides, and play areas. Read More event Bunnyland Festival at Butler's Orchard event Germantown, MD Multiple dates, March 28 - April 12 Ages 12 and underBunnyland at Butler's Orchard includes hayrides through a decorated trail, goodie baskets, an egg hunt, jump pads, giant slides, photos with the Easter Bunny, and more. Read More event Leesburg Animal Park Easter Egg Hunts event Leesburg, VA Saturdays & Sundays, March 28-April 5 Ages 11 and underLeesburg Animal Park hosts Easter egg hunts on four different days, separated by age group. The eggs are filled with small toys. Beyond the hunts, families can enjoy live music, food, professional face painting, pony rides, and a meet-and-greet with the Easter Bunny. Read More event Easter Egg-Stravaganza at Black Barn Alpacas event Pick Finksburg, MD March 28 & 29 and April 3 & 4 All agesHead to the Egg-Stravaganza at Black Barn Alpacas this Easter! An Easter egg hunt, the Easter bunny AND alpacas, plus crafts and lawn games – what could be better? Read More event Spring Egg Hunt at Temple Hall Farm event 11:00 am -12:30 pm Leesburg, VA Wednesday, April 1 Ages 2-12Children are invited to celebrate spring with crafts, photos with the Easter Bunny, and an egg hunt. Read More event Willow Oak Flower & Herb Farm Easter Egg Hunt event 10:30 am -2:00 pm Severn, MD Saturday, April 4 Ages 3 and upKids can take a photo with the Easter Bunny and look for eggs in the Willow Oak Flower & Herb Farm gardens. Read More Hunt for eggs in the pool at Reston Community Center. Event photo courtesy of Reston Community Center Unique Easter Egg Hunts Near DC for Family Fun event Underwater Egg Hunt at Reston Community Center event 12:30 pm -4:00 pm Reston, VA Saturday, March 21 Ages 6 months - 9 yearsThe Easter egg hunt tradition takes on an exciting aquatic twist as kids search for eggs floating in or on the bottom of the pool. Each participating child receives a goody bag after the event. Read More event Dinosaur Egg Hunt at Hidden Oaks Nature Center event Annandale, VA Saturday & Sunday, March 21 & 22 Ages 3-8Go on an outdoor egg hunt at Dinoland in Nature Playce. Participants can also enjoy dinosaur-themed activities. Read More event Family Flashlight Egg Hunt at Glyndon Park event 6:45 pm -8:15 pm Vienna, VA Friday, March 27 All agesFamilies can search for eggs and prizes in the dark using their flashlights. The Easter Bunny is available for visits before the egg hunt starts. Read More event Mini-Golf Egg-plorations (at Oakmont Rec Center) event 11:00 am -3:00 pm Oakton, VA Saturday, March 28 Ages 2-9Hop on over to Oakmont Mini Golf for an egg hunt throughout the mini golf course. In addition, enjoy face painting, popcorn, games, and an Easter egg craft. Read More event Potomac Overlook Easter Egg Hunt event 10:30 am -4:00 pm Arlington, VA Saturday, March 28 Ages 2-10Kids are invited to visit Potomac Overlook Regional Park for an ongoing Easter egg hunt anytime between 10:30am and 4pm. Participants should pick up their egg hunt sheet at the nature center, explore the park on a scavenger hunt, and return their completed sheet to the nature center for a prize. Read More event Egg-streme Teen Night Egg Hunt (at Historic Blenheim) event 7:30 pm -8:15 pm Pick Fairfax, VA Thursday, April 2 Ages 10-14Teens are invited to a special nighttime egg hunt designed just for them, where they can search for eggs and prizes in the dark with their flashlights. Read More event Bubbles & Bunnies at Cub Run Rec Center event Various times -11:59 pm Chantilly, VA Saturday, April 4 Ages 2-12Hop on over to Cub Run Rec Center to help the Easter Bunny find his missing eggs in the leisure pool. After finding the thousands of eggs, stay and enjoy the slides, lazy river, and play features. Read More So many Easter egg hunts, so little time! Photo by Kelly Patino for Mommy Poppins Best Easter Egg Hunts Near DC with Additional Activities event Eggstravaganza! at Tudor Place event Washington, DC Friday, March 27 & 28 All agesCome out for Eggstravaganza!, a favorite spring tradition. Children of all ages can take part in a lively Easter egg hunt and egg roll on the south lawn of Tudor Place. Afterwards, make crafts and take a picture with the Easter Bunny. Read More event Easter Egg Hunt at Ida Lee Park event 12:00 pm -3:00 pm Leesburg, VA Saturday, March 28 Ages 1-8Children are invited to hop along the bunny trail, take pictures with the Easter bunny, and hunt for eggs in Ida Lee Park. Each child can hunt for empty Easter eggs and receive a treat bag at the conclusion of the hunt. Read More event Springtime in Morven Park event 10:00 am -12:00 pm Leesburg, VA Saturday, March 28 Ages 2-12Celebrate the beginning of spring in the historic Morven Park gardens with an Easter egg hunt and egg roll, games, crafts, and a picture with the Easter Bunny. Read More event Hoppy Egg Hunting at Bready Park event 9:30 am -12:00 pm Herndon, VA Saturday, April 4 Ages 1-10Families are invited to bring their cameras and baskets for a fun egg hunt in the park, plus games, arts and crafts, music, and a photo op with the Easter Bunny. Read More event Easter at Capital One Center event 9:00 am -2:00 pm Pick McLean, VA Saturday, April 4 All agesGuests can enjoy a variety of springtime festivities all over Capital One Center including the return of the popular “Color Fun Run” (perfect for all ages), the ultimate Easter Egg Hunt with 3,000 eggs on the Great Lawn at The Perch, goat yoga, a petting zoo, a meet-and-greet with the Easter Bunny, and so much more. Read More event Easter Egg Hunt at Colvin Run Mill event 11:00 am -3:00 pm Great Falls, VA Saturday, April 4 Ages 2-9Hunt for eggs filled with treats and treasures on the grounds of Colvin Run Mill Historic Site. Before the hunt, make egg-cellent crafts to take home. Read More event Baskets & Bunnies at Burke Lake Park event 10:00 am -5:00 pm Fairfax Station, VA Saturday, April 4 Ages 1-7Visit Sunny the Bunny at Burke Lake Park. Go on an egg hunt, ride the carousel, play games and mini golf, and make spring crafts. Read More event Easter Eggstravaganza at Bladensburg Waterfront Park event 12:00 pm -5:00 pm Bladensburg, MD Saturday, April 4 All ages Come and enjoy a day of fun activities with the Easter Bunny and Friends. The day includes an egg hunt, arts and crafts, games, pictures with the Easter Bunny, and more. Read More Have breakfast with the Easter Bunny at the B&O Railroad Museum. Photo courtesy of the museum Indoor Easter Egg Hunts Near DC In Case of Rain! event Easter Treasure Hunt & Candy at O Street Mansion event Various times -11:59 pm Washington, DC Thursday - Monday, April 3-6 All ages Families are invited to put on their finest Easter attire and go on an Easter-themed treasure hunt at the Mansion on O Street. Kids can explore the secret rooms searching for eggs, enjoy candy, and maybe win a prize for best dressed and best Easter bonnet. Read More event Breakfast with the Easter Bunny & Egg Hunt (at B&O Railroad Museum) event 8:30 am -10:30 am Baltimore, MD Saturday, April 4 Ages 12 and underStart the day off right with a breakfast buffet, a visit from the Easter Bunny, and an egg hunt. After breakfast, climb aboard for a 10am train ride. Families can also take photos with the Easter Bunny. Read More Did you like this article? Subscribe to our newsletter to get more like this.
